privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.dataProcessingText: 0trace uses WebRTC peer-to-peer technology for file transfers. All files are transferred directly between your device and the receiver's device, without passing through our servers. Our servers are only used to establish connections (signaling) and do not store, view, or record any file content.
privacy.noTrackingText: We do not use any analytics tools, cookies, or tracking technologies. We do not collect your personal information, IP address, or usage data.
privacy.securityText: File transfers use WebRTC encrypted connections (DTLS/SRTP). However, please note that anyone with the share link can receive files, so share links carefully.

intro.title: What is 0trace?
intro.description: 0trace is a pure two-person WebRTC session. Chat messages and files move directly between devices without server relay.
intro.howToSend: Create a session → Copy the link → Share it → Chat and send files in one timeline
intro.howToReceive: Open the link or enter the code → Build the P2P connection → Start chatting or transferring files
